name: print-social-cobalt-step-four-poster-title-and-object-tutorial-slide
title: Step 4 Object, Gradient and Title Tutorial
whatItIs: A cobalt slide with glossy 'Step 4', instructions to add an object, gradient and title, a finished red poster of laughing children with a script title, and dotted arrows pointing to a small reference photo and notes about gradients.
whatItMeans: Showing the near-finished poster with arrows to its ingredients makes the process feel reproducible, and casual notes add personality.
techniques: Dotted arrows linking notes to poster parts
Reference cut-out shown beside the result
Script title with white outline on the poster
Consistent tutorial chrome and swipe cue

vocabulary.definition: A note and arrow pointing to one element used in a design.
A display headline in a script typeface.
A border around lettering to lift it from a background.
